17592186101725 :step/content {:db/id 17592186102033 :tutorial/content "A differential equation of the form

$$
\dfrac{\mathrm dy}{\mathrm dt} = ky(a-y),
$$

where $y=y(t)$ is called a **logistic growth equation.** 

Note the following:

- $a$ is a positive constant called the **carrying capacity**.

- $k$ is a positive constant of proportionality.

A typical solution curve $y = y(t)$ to this equation is shown below:

![](images/0f/0f416479bbf72d3b9c1bf48861883e0e77bbc1c1d60d7fa48fb89e6f21c104eb.png)

We will learn more about the structure of the solution curves in future lessons. But for now, it's helpful to realize that for all $t,$ we have

$$
0 < y(t) < a.
$$

 

An example of a logistic growth equation is

$$
\dfrac{\mathrm dy}{\mathrm dt} = 10y(50-y).
$$

Here, $k = 10$ and the carrying capacity is $a=50.$" :tutorial/id #uuid "f5791475-4f91-5859-9d5b-1f20283522ea" :tutorial/math-academy-id 982 :tutorial/title "Introduction"} :step/id #uuid "a86bd27c-35f7-56a0-9dd4-1415fb4b1ae3" :step/math-academy-id 1925 :step/next {:db/id 17592186101786}} {:db/id 17592186101785 :step/content {:db/id 17592186100942 :knowledge-point/canonical-example {:db/id 17592186100777 :question/id #uuid "a16c2c4f-38c3-5e8c-8962-3ad6c956748a" :question/math-academy-id "e-7321"} :knowledge-point/id #uuid "a46e688b-117f-5394-bcbb-fbfb7a5b6c7b" :knowledge-point/key-prerequisites [{:db/id 17592186048127} {:db/id 17592186048746}] :knowledge-point/questions [{:db/id 17592186101197} {:db/id 17592186101551} {:db/id 17592186253559} {:db/id 17592186253560} {:db/id 17592186253561} {:db/id 17592186351557} {:db/id 17592186351558}] :knowledge-point/title "Constructing a Logistic Growth Equation"} :step/id #uuid "fa88498c-b724-5dfa-b5a3-3f4d0dbea254" :step/math-academy-id 27104} {:db/id 17592186101786 :step/content {:db/id 17592186100943 :knowledge-point/canonical-example {:db/id 17592186100779 :question/id #uuid "29ee4686-7e38-5000-9d89-58e572f84cd7" :question/math-academy-id "e-7404"} :knowledge-point/id #uuid "a4751337-93bf-5b47-8b3f-32100820b19a" :knowledge-point/key-prerequisites [{:db/id 17592186051017}] :knowledge-point/questions [{:db/id 17592186101549} {:db/id 17592186101550} {:db/id 17592186253556} {:db/id 17592186253557} {:db/id 17592186253558} {:db/id 17592186351555} {:db/id 17592186351556}] :knowledge-point/title "Identifying a Logistic Growth Differential Equation"} :step/id #uuid "257b95d0-a448-51aa-936a-9acc386bda17" :step/math-academy-id 27468 :step/next {:db/id 17592186101800}} {:db/id 17592186101800 :step/content {:db/id 17592186101996 :tutorial/content "Suppose we want to create a model of the deer population in a forest. $$
